chapter: Bands, leaders and radio of the thirties and forties
title: Stan King's drumming compared with Morehouse's
summary: Kline asks how Stan King played differently; Morehouse says he remembers well, that King played all by himself as a soloist, and that Morehouse took no solos.

bands.name: Chauncey Morehouse and his N'goma band

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Right. Okay. I asked Chauncey before about someone else whose name keeps popping up along with his on drums. And that's Stan King.
Did you ever run into his name?
Only the name. And apparently when Chauncey had his own band and Chauncey was in N'goma, he had Stan King.
But he doesn't remember. You don't remember anything about the man himself. Do you?
Do you remember that he played drums differently from you?
How did he play? What's the difference?
What's the difference between the way he played and you played or anybody else played. Do you remember?
He would play all by himself.
Soloist, okay. Did you take solos?
You didn't take solos. Why not?
